01
PE-backed rollups
/ MULTI-STATE PLATFORMS · INSTITUTIONAL
The lifetime niche. ( Institutional capital. Professional management. Quarterly vendor reviews already running. KPIs already tracked. )

Pay: $30K–$100K tier. Reply rate: 35–50% (highest). Churn: lowest — contracts honored. Friction: 60–90 day cycle, 2–3 weeks legal review. LTV: highest. Lifetime potential: yes.
/ Rank
02
GLP-1 weight loss
/ MOCHI · SEQUENCE · CALIBRATE MODEL
Fastest-growing aesthetic category 2025–2026. ( $500–$1,200/mo subscription revenue per patient. Cash-rich. Founders under 40. Comfortable with AI vendors. )

Pay: $15K–$30K tier sweet spot. Reply rate: 35–45%. Churn: low. Friction: fast deciders. Risk: regulatory headwinds if FDA tightens compounded GLP-1 rules.
/ Rank
03
Founder-owned multi-location
/ 3–8 SITES · $8M–$25M REVENUE
Founder still in the chair. ( Cash flow strong. Decisions made solo or by founder+spouse. Reply rates 30–40%. )

Pay: $15K Executive tier. Reply rate: 30–40%. Risk: emotional deciders — sign fast, cancel fast. Mitigation: 6-month minimum holds. LTV: high when retained past month 3.
/ Rank
04
Botox / filler chains
/ EVER/BODY · ALCHEMY 43 · SKINLY MODEL
Recurring 3–4 month patient cycles. ( Perfect for Operator recall sequences. Margin pressure from competition makes them receptive to replacement claims. )

Pay: $15K–$30K Department sweet spot. Reply rate: 25–35%. Friction: multi-partner LLCs slow decisions. Operator ROI: outsized via recall pipeline.
/ Rank
05
Body contouring chains
/ COOLSCULPTING · EMSCULPT-LED
High AOV $3K–$8K per treatment cycle. ( Pain is lead leakage between consultation and treatment. Closer drives outsized ROI here. )

Pay: $15K–$30K tier. Reply rate: 25–30%. Friction: device-manufacturer partnerships slow vendor evaluation. Closer impact: highest of all five.
/ Why these
beat the rest

Dermatology has insurance billing complexity. Hair restoration too narrow. IV bars too low-ticket. Sexual wellness has privacy constraints. Plastic surgery treats med spa as side hustle. Hormone clinics inconsistent on staff churn. Stay locked on #1 or #2 for Year 1. Extend to #3 and #4 after 4 closes. #5 only if referral lands.

Send 30 audit Looms over 6 weeks. Target Executive-tier candidates: 3–6 location med spas, $5M–$15M revenue, sole owner or partner LLC. Expected: 9 replies, 5–6 demos, 2 closes minimum.

Result: 3 Executive = $45K MRR. Or 2 Executive + 1 Department = $60K MRR. Most predictable path. Strongest moat-building.

01
